question:
Simplify the following expression.

20 + 3 - 2 + (4 - 1)
solution:
Given:

20 + 3 - 2 + (4 - 1)

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83ad200c05af7ff0a96c689e1309a38eee4e23c73e3e9636ad108a7806b6c852.png] 

Calculation:

20 + 3 - 2 + (4 - 1)

⇒ 20 + 3 - 2 + 3

⇒ 26 - 2

⇒ 24

∴ The simplified value is 24.
